title: v0.32.7
factSummary: Muse Glimmer Note: Muse Glimmer is currently available via initial support via Ollama's MLX engine on Apple Silicon. Additional support and optimizations for Apple Silicon, NVIDIA, AMD, and other platforms will be available in the coming days. Muse Glimmer , Meta's newest open model and the first released by Meta Superintelligence Labs, is now available on Ollama. It's a 30B multimodal model purpose-built for agent workloads that run locally. With Ollama, you can now use Muse Glimmer to power coding agent applications such as Claude Code, Codex, Pi and more, as well as long-running personal assistants such as OpenClaw and Hermes. Ollama's MLX engine provides state-of-the-art performance on Apple Silicon for this model, with support for DFlash and image input as of Ollama 0.32.7. To download and run Muse Glimmer locally: ollama run muse-glimmer:30b-mlx To run Muse Glimmer on Apple Silicon with Claude Code, download Ollama and run: ollama launch claude --model muse-glimmer:30b-mlx For a lighter-weight coding agent, try Pi : ollama launch pi --model muse-glimmer:30b-mlx For personal assistant frameworks such as OpenClaw and Hermes, use: ollama launch openclaw --model muse-glimmer:30b-mlx ollama launch hermes --model muse-glimmer:30b-mlx

title: v0.34.2-rc2: mlxrunner: Release freed KV buffers during speculative decode
factSummary: Ollama 发布 v0.34.2-rc2，修复 mlxrunner 在投机解码（speculative decode）中的 KV 缓冲区释放问题。原逻辑每生成 256 个 token 释放一次 MLX 已释放缓冲区池，但检查仅在 token 数恰好落在 256 的整数倍时触发；投机解码每轮生成多个 token，多数轮次会跨过该边界，导致缓冲区池从不释放。长上下文下每次 KV 缓存增长都会留下数 GB 无法被后续分配复用的缓冲区，使 runner 内存占用持续攀升直至系统内存耗尽。修复后，只要一轮跨过 256 的整数倍就释放缓冲区池，与单 token 轮次原有行为一致。在 128 GB 机器、98k token 上下文、qwen3.8:27b-mlx 模型下，长投机生成此前会使 runner 超过 90 GB 并触发内核 panic，现在稳定在 30 GB。
summary: Ollama v0.34.2-rc2 修复了 mlxrunner 在投机解码下的 KV 缓冲区释放缺陷：原释放检查只在 token 数恰好为 256 整数倍时触发，而投机解码每轮输出多个 token 常跨过边界，导致长上下文生成时内存持续增长。修复后改为每轮跨过 256 整数倍即释放，官方给出的 qwen3.8:27b-mlx 在 98k 上下文、128 GB 机器上的测试显示内存从超过 90 GB 并 panic 降至稳定 30 GB。
technicalInsight: 该修复针对的是投机解码与周期性资源回收之间的边界条件不匹配：按精确倍数触发的回收逻辑在每轮产出多 token 时被跳过，属于典型的步长假设错误。改为跨边界触发后，回收频率与 KV 缓存增长节奏重新对齐，长上下文内存曲线由持续上升转为平稳。可验证的下一信号是后续 rc 或正式版是否将该逻辑推广到其他后端，以及是否补充针对跨边界场景的回归测试。
industryInsight: 本地推理运行时在长上下文与投机解码组合下的内存管理仍是工程薄弱点，此类缺陷会直接影响消费级与工作站级硬件的可用上下文长度。Ollama 以发布说明形式公开具体内存数据，说明本地推理的竞争点正从模型支持转向长上下文稳定性与资源效率。可验证的下一信号是其他本地推理项目是否跟进类似的缓冲区回收策略或发布对比数据。
futureOutlook: 若该修复在正式版中保持，长上下文投机解码在 128 GB 级设备上的可用性将提升，但 30 GB 的稳定占用仍意味着上下文长度与并发受硬件约束。可验证的下一信号是正式版发布说明中的内存数据是否与 rc 一致，以及是否出现针对更低内存设备的进一步优化。
businessValue: 对使用 Ollama 进行本地长上下文生成的开发者与团队，该修复降低了因内存耗尽导致进程崩溃的风险，减少重试与资源监控成本。可验证的下一信号是正式版发布后用户报告的长上下文稳定性与内存占用是否与官方数据吻合。

title: v0.34.4

title: v0.5.16
factSummary: SGLang v0.5.16 发布，包含 574 个 PR，来自 169 位贡献者。新增 DSpark 推测解码算法，在 DeepSeek-V4-Pro 上达到 383.7 tok/s。新增 Inkling 模型支持，975B 参数多模态 MoE，1M 上下文，在 Blackwell 上达到 71.7k tok/s 输入和 171.0 tok/s 每用户解码。

title: v0.5.17
factSummary: SGLang v0.5.17 发布，包含 582 个 PR，来自 194 位贡献者。新增对 Kimi K3 和 MiniMax-H3 的 day-0 支持。Kimi K3 是一个 2.8T 参数的多模态 LatentMoE 模型，具有 896 个专家、top-16 路由、3584 维潜在空间、1M token 上下文、69 个 KDA 线性注意力层与 24 个 MLA 层交错、MoonViT3d 视觉塔，以原生 MXFP4 检查点发布。SGLang 从 day-0 起通过 DCP、DSpark 推测解码、chunked-prefill PP 与 TP decode、KDA-aware 前缀缓存、HiCache L2 over DCP、量化权重上的 LoRA 以及推理、工具调用和 OpenAI 兼容服务来服务该模型，并在 NVIDIA GB300 和 AMD MI35x 上验证。MiniMax-H3 是 MiniMax 的视频生成模型，可在一个请求中生成视频和同步立体声音轨，在 SGLang-Diffusion 上原生服务，覆盖所有三个公共任务配置文件：t2va、fl2va 和 ref2va。在 B200（TP2 + Ulysses4）、H100（TP2 + Ulysses2）和 2x RTX 5090 上验证，并支持 layerwise offload。

title: v1.10.0
factSummary: Hugging Face TRL 发布 v1.10.0，将 DistillationTrainer 和 DistillationConfig 从 trl.experimental.distillation 提升至顶层 trl 包，旧路径仍可用并发出 FutureWarning（计划 v2.0.0 移除）。重构涉及约 30 个 PR，包括将签名列改为 prompt、生成栈对齐 GRPO、接入分块 JSD loss 并删除全 logit 路径、清理 Liger 路径、采用 GRPO 的 log()/training_step 计时/_save_checkpoint，测试套件重构为 GRPO 形态，并新增 trl distillation CLI。
summary: Hugging Face TRL 在 v1.10.0 中将蒸馏训练器稳定化，从实验模块提升为顶层 API，接口与 SFT/DPO/GRPO/KTO 一致，并配套 CLI 与测试迁移。
technicalInsight: 蒸馏训练器与 GRPO 生成栈、日志和检查点逻辑对齐，可能降低蒸馏与强化学习工作流的集成成本。下一信号：v2.0.0 移除旧路径后，蒸馏 API 的采用率变化。
industryInsight: 蒸馏训练器稳定化可能推动模型压缩在开源生态中的标准化，与 GRPO 等偏好优化方法形成互补。下一信号：其他框架是否跟进类似蒸馏 API 设计。
futureOutlook: 蒸馏能力与 GRPO 对齐可能使蒸馏成为对齐流程的常规环节，未来版本或扩展更多蒸馏策略。下一信号：后续版本是否增加新的蒸馏损失或数据格式支持。
businessValue: 开源蒸馏工具稳定化可降低企业模型压缩成本，提升 TRL 生态吸引力。下一信号：相关企业采用蒸馏工作流的案例数量。

title: v1.22.0
factSummary: OpenHands 发布 v1.22.0（2026-09-22），变更包括：通过 app server 在云后端测试远程 MCP 服务器（#17276）、向云后端组织管理员开放 Git Sync（#17216）、翻译新增土耳其语 UI 字符串（#17581）；修复向组织成员显示 add automation 菜单（#17526）、canvas 离开应用时保留 base path（#17617）、保存到云后端时保留同级 MCP 服务器（#17467）、将 home automation 行链接到 automation 视图（#17466）、隐藏服务器标记 is_visible=false 的云组织（#17624）；文档方面在 Canvas review guide 中加入仓库与产品范围（#17606）；维护方面升级测试依赖组（#17589）、消费 SDK 1.49.4 与 Automation 1.14.0（#17628）。同一时间窗口内，AG2 发布 v1.0.6（2026-09-21），变更包括修复 MCP 资源模板 URI 变量解码（#3250）、让被服务的 agent 拥有其 HTTP 传输设置（#3252）、为 tealtiger 增加 rate_limit 治理策略（#3246）、按读取渲染 MemorySkill 正文（#3254）。
summary: 两个开源 Agent 项目在同一时间窗口发布版本：OpenHands v1.22.0 聚焦云后端上的远程 MCP 服务器测试、Git Sync 权限开放与 canvas/automation 修复；AG2 v1.0.6 聚焦 MCP 资源模板 URI 解码、agent 自有 HTTP 传输设置、rate_limit 治理策略与 MemorySkill 按读取渲染。
technicalInsight: 证据显示两个项目都在 MCP 集成与 agent 运行时配置上做增量修补：OpenHands 处理云后端下 MCP 服务器保存与远程测试，AG2 处理 MCP 资源模板 URI 变量解码与 agent 自有 HTTP 传输设置。这属于工程细节层面的收敛，尚不足以判断架构方向变化。可验证下一信号：后续版本是否出现 MCP 相关的新增能力（而非修复）或跨项目兼容性说明。
industryInsight: 两个独立开源 Agent 项目在同一周发布版本，且都涉及 MCP 与权限/治理（Git Sync 组织管理员、rate_limit 策略），提示 MCP 已成为 Agent 工具链的常规集成面。但证据仅为 release notes，无法据此判断采用规模或商业影响。可验证下一信号：是否有第三方项目或企业文档引用这些 MCP 相关变更。
futureOutlook: 若 MCP 集成持续以修复与权限治理为主，短期内更可能看到配置一致性与多后端兼容性改进，而非新协议能力。可验证下一信号：下一版本 release notes 中 MCP 相关条目是否从 fix 转为 feat，以及是否出现 SDK 版本联动升级。
businessValue: 对使用 OpenHands 或 AG2 的团队，本次变更的直接价值在于云后端 MCP 服务器保存与远程测试、Git Sync 权限控制、rate_limit 治理策略等运维与权限细节的稳定性提升；但证据未提供性能、成本或采用数据，无法量化收益。可验证下一信号：项目是否发布迁移说明或破坏性变更提示。

title: v1.29.0
factSummary: MCP Python SDK 发布 v1.29.0，包含 Streamable HTTP 请求体限制、工具名验证修复、文档改进等变更。
summary: MCP Python SDK 发布 v1.29.0，主要变更包括：将 Context.report_progress() 路由到原始请求流、发布 llms.txt 和 Markdown 文档、添加 Streamable HTTP 请求体限制、拒绝工具名中的尾随换行符、将 v1.x 文档移至 /v1/ 并标记为维护线。
technicalInsight: Streamable HTTP 请求体限制的添加表明 MCP 协议在流式传输场景下对资源控制的关注，可能影响长连接或大负载请求的稳定性。
industryInsight: MCP Python SDK 作为模型上下文协议的关键实现，其版本更新反映了 AI 工具链中协议层对可靠性和文档化的持续投入。
futureOutlook: 可关注后续版本是否引入更细粒度的流控或安全机制，以及 v1.x 维护线是否会有安全修复。
businessValue: 提升 MCP 协议的稳定性和可用性，有助于吸引更多开发者采用该协议构建 AI 应用，间接推动生态发展。

title: v1.62.0
factSummary: Playwright v1.62.0 引入了新的组件测试模型，基于 stories 和 galleries，并支持 AbortSignal 取消操作。
summary: Playwright v1.62.0 发布，新增组件测试模型（stories/galleries）和 AbortSignal 取消操作。
technicalInsight: 组件测试模型通过 stories 封装组件场景，galleries 按需渲染，fixtures.mount() 返回 Locator 支持 update/unmount，提升测试灵活性和可维护性。
industryInsight: 该更新反映了前端测试工具向更细粒度、可组合的测试模式演进，与组件驱动开发趋势一致。
futureOutlook: 后续可能看到更多测试框架采用类似 stories 模式，或 Playwright 进一步集成可视化调试。
businessValue: 降低组件测试编写和维护成本，提升开发者体验，巩固 Playwright 在端到端测试市场的竞争力。

title: v1.90.6
factSummary: Verify Docker Image Signature All LiteLLM Docker images are signed with cosign . Every release is signed with the same key introduced in commit 0112e53 . Verify using the pinned commit hash (recommended): A commit hash is cryptographically immutable, so this is the strongest way to ensure you are using the original signing key: cosign verify \ --key https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BerriAI/litellm/0112e53046018d726492c814b3644b7d376029d0/cosign.pub \ ghcr.io/berriai/litellm:v1.90.6 Verify using the release tag (convenience): Tags are protected in this repository and resolve to the same key. This option is easier to read but relies on tag protection rules: cosign verify \ --key https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BerriAI/litellm/v1.90.6/cosign.pub \ ghcr.io/berriai/litellm:v1.90.6 Expected output: The following checks were performed on each of these signatures: - The cosign claims were validated - The signatures were verified against the specified public key What's Changed chore(release): backport #33853 to stable/1.90.x and cut 1.90.6 by @yuneng-berri in #33902 Full Changelog : v1.90.5...v1.90.6

title: v2.1.221
factSummary: Claude Code 发布 v2.1.221，新增 Focus view 功能，可隐藏工具活动并显示可展开的逐轮摘要和实时运行工具指示器，通过 Ctrl+Alt+F 或命令切换。新增 Linux 和 WSL 上的 sandbox 凭据文件 mask 模式，macOS 上回退为 deny。claude plugin validate 增加对 marketplace 和插件名称的警告。claude-api skill 新增 prompt-audit 子命令。修复了 Bash 工具权限检查绕过（zsh 在 [[ ]] 正则条件中执行隐藏命令）、Windows 上 PowerShell 权限检查对含引号路径的处理、thinking 开关在会话中失效等问题。
summary: Anthropic 发布 Claude Code v2.1.221，引入 Focus view 以简化工具活动展示，增强 sandbox 凭据文件掩码，并修复多个安全与功能问题。
technicalInsight: Focus view 将工具活动折叠为逐轮摘要，可能减少用户认知负担，但需观察其对调试效率的实际影响。mask 模式通过 sentinel 副本和 egress 替换实现凭据保护，macOS 回退为 deny，表明跨平台安全策略存在差异。
industryInsight: Claude Code 的更新聚焦于开发者体验和安全修复，反映 AI 编程助手在安全性和可用性上的竞争加剧。
futureOutlook: 后续可关注 Focus view 的用户反馈、mask 模式在 macOS 上的支持进展，以及类似安全修复是否出现在其他 AI 编程工具中。
businessValue: 增强的安全性和可用性可能提升 Claude Code 在企业开发者中的采用率，巩固 Anthropic 在 AI 编程工具市场的地位。

title: v2.1.222
factSummary: Claude Code v2.1.222 修复了多个问题：工作树隔离会话及其子代理不再能对主检出运行破坏性 git 命令，隔离现在适用于所有会话类型的文件编辑和 Bash；PreToolUse 自动允许钩子不再绕过后台代理任务中的工具限制；Team 和 Enterprise 的 /usage-credits 修复了成员请求被驳回后无法再次发送的问题；启动连接检查在 HTTPS 代理后不再挂起或失败，现在使用与 API 请求相同的代理感知传输并超时显示清晰消息；修复了已完成响应被报告为“连接中途关闭”错误的问题；/usage 不再过度归因 MCP 服务器，服务器份额仅反映实际消耗其工具结果的请求；修复了分支推送后（包括通过 GitHub REST API）会话未链接到拉取请求的问题；修复了组织受限模型 opus 风格子代理和队友家族别名降级到父模型的问题。
summary: Claude Code 发布 v2.1.222，主要修复安全隔离、工具限制绕过、代理兼容性、MCP 用量统计和链接问题，提升稳定性和准确性。
technicalInsight: 修复表明 Claude Code 在强化会话隔离和工具权限控制，防止子代理越权执行破坏性操作，同时优化代理网络兼容性和 MCP 用量归因逻辑。
industryInsight: 此版本聚焦企业级稳定性和安全修复，反映 AI 编程工具在团队协作场景中对权限管理和可靠性日益重视。
futureOutlook: 后续版本可能继续加强安全边界和代理环境支持，并优化 MCP 集成统计准确性。
businessValue: 提升企业用户信任度，减少因权限绕过和网络问题导致的故障，增强产品在团队协作中的竞争力。

title: v2.1.223
factSummary: Claude Code v2.1.223 发布，新增 owner 通配符条目到 strictKnownMarketplaces 和 blockedMarketplaces 管理设置，用于允许或阻止 GitHub 组织下的所有市场仓库；当工作流代理、forked skills、斜杠命令或恢复的后台代理请求的子代理模型受限时添加警告，并改用父模型运行；在云会话中添加 /teleport 提示，展示如何使用 claude --teleport 在本地继续。修复了 Bash 权限绕过、权限提示中命令被制表符或不可见 Unicode 填充隐藏、工作流脚本使用动态 import() 在沙箱外运行代码、代理定义的 bypassPermissions 模式忽略组织禁用策略、会话恢复后 /cd 为空、网关模型发现隐藏了 provider 前缀 ID 注册的 Claude 模型、modelOverrides 键非 Anthropic 模型等问题。

businessValue: Claude Code 的安全修复和功能增强有助于提升企业用户信任，巩固 Anthropic 在 AI 编程工具市场的地位。

industryInsight: Claude Code 持续迭代，聚焦开发者体验与远程会话管理，反映 AI 编程工具正从单机向云端、自托管混合架构演进。

title: v2.1.231
factSummary: Claude Code 发布 v2.1.231 版本，修复了 MCP OAuth 登录时因重定向 URI 不匹配而失败的问题，该问题影响使用预注册 OAuth 客户端（如 Slack）的服务器。Cherry Studio 发布 v2.0.5 版本，包含多项修复和性能优化，如修复 provider-registry 中模型 ID 冲突、减少冷启动内存占用、同步跨窗口 pin 更改、使跨助手移动原子化、限制后台内存使用、删除超出 SQLite 级联深度限制的会话、隔离日志标签更新、限制非活动会话历史缓存、添加内置支持代理、避免重复刷新和树重新获取、虚拟化消息预览、添加应用更新通知偏好、查询 OVMS 可服务模型等。
summary: Claude Code 和 Cherry Studio 分别发布了新版本，修复了多个问题并进行了性能优化。Claude Code 修复了 MCP OAuth 登录问题，Cherry Studio 则包含多项修复和性能改进。
technicalInsight: Claude Code 的修复表明 MCP 生态中 OAuth 客户端注册和重定向 URI 匹配是常见问题，需要更健壮的兼容性处理。Cherry Studio 的更新显示桌面 AI 应用在内存管理和跨窗口同步方面持续优化，以提升用户体验。
industryInsight: AI 开发工具和桌面应用正在快速迭代，修复和优化频繁，反映了市场竞争激烈和用户对稳定性和性能的高要求。

businessValue: 这些更新有助于提升开发者工具和桌面应用的可靠性，增强用户粘性，可能促进相关产品的采用和商业成功。

title: v2.1.232
factSummary: Claude Code v2.1.232 发布，默认启用 subagent forking，subagent_type: "fork" 继承完整对话和 prompt cache；交互式会话中非 teammate agent 默认后台运行；支持在提示中输入 @ 提及另一个 Claude 会话，Claude 使用 SendMessage 直接到达该会话；SendMessage 现在直接投递给与活动会话完全匹配的裸名称；同一机器上的交互式会话保持唯一名称，重名时自动添加 word-word 变体；新增 /config 行 "Dialog expiry" 和 "Messages from your other sessions"；新增 GitLab token 家族（glrt-, gloas-, glptt-, glagent-, glimt-, glsoat-, glcbt-, glft-, glffct-）的 secret 脱敏，以及可路由的 glpat-/gldt- token 的完整脱敏；glab CLI 配置存储获得与 gh 相同的沙箱和凭据路径保护；插件市场新增 GitLab 支持，裸 gitlab.com 仓库 URL（包括嵌套子组）可像 github.com URL 一样克隆。
summary: Claude Code v2.1.232 发布，默认启用 subagent forking，支持跨会话 @ 提及和 SendMessage 直接投递，新增 GitLab token 脱敏和插件市场 GitLab 支持。
technicalInsight: 该版本强化了多会话协作机制，subagent forking 默认开启并继承完整上下文，@ 提及和 SendMessage 直接投递降低了跨会话通信延迟，可能提升复杂任务分解效率。
industryInsight: Claude Code 持续扩展 GitLab 生态支持，包括 token 脱敏和插件市场克隆，显示 Anthropic 在开发者工具链上加深与 GitLab 的集成，可能影响开发者工具市场竞争格局。
futureOutlook: 后续可观察 Claude Code 是否进一步支持更多 Git 平台（如 Bitbucket）的插件市场集成，以及跨会话协作是否引入更细粒度的权限控制。
businessValue: 通过增强多会话协作和 GitLab 集成，Claude Code 可能提升开发者生产力和企业采用率，巩固 Anthropic 在 AI 编程助手市场的地位。

title: v2.1.233
factSummary: Claude Code v2.1.233 于 2026-08-14 发布，新增 GitLab 合并请求 URL 支持、可选的 forward_user_identity 应用网关设置、Linux 上 Bash 工具命令的可选内存 cgroup 支持，以及 CLAUDE_CODE_WEBFETCH_CACHE_TTL_MS 环境变量。修复了云会话丢失、MCP v2 连接重开、通知钩子未触发和 Linux 空闲会话 CPU 占用等问题。
summary: Claude Code 发布 v2.1.233，主要包含 GitLab 集成、用户身份转发、内存限制和缓存配置等新功能，并修复了多个稳定性问题。
technicalInsight: 该版本通过内存 cgroup 限制和 WebFetch 缓存 TTL 配置，增强了代理在资源受限环境下的稳定性；forward_user_identity 支持按用户归因支出，表明代理网关正在向企业级可观测性演进。
industryInsight: Claude Code 的更新聚焦于企业工作流集成（GitLab）和资源管理，反映出 AI 编码代理正从实验性工具转向生产环境的关键路径。

title: v2.1.274
factSummary: Claude Code 发布 v2.1.274，新增内存使用临界时的可见警告及释放内存或安全重启的步骤；新增 CLAUDE_CODE_MCP_STARTUP_WAIT_MS 用于限制首个非交互轮次等待 MCP 服务器连接的时间（0 表示不等待）；在 claude_code.llm_request OpenTelemetry trace span 中新增 effort 属性，与 api_request 事件一致；新增 claude_code.managed_settings_resolved OTel 事件，记录 managed-settings 来源与策略辅助状态，并在 OTEL_LOG_MANAGED_SETTINGS=1 时对设置与摘要做脱敏；新增 store.connect_timeout_seconds 以延长 Postgres 连接超时（默认 5 秒），并改进数据库不可达时的启动错误提示；在 Claude Desktop 与 Cowork 通过 Claude apps gateway 发送的遥测中新增 enduser.sub（IdP subject）；新增当副本打开的请求数超过其一次向上游发送的 256 上限时的网关警告，以及显示该上限的启动日志行；全屏模式下折叠的队友与 agent 消息支持点击展开；修复会话陷入无限重试的问题。
summary: Claude Code v2.1.274 是一次以可观测性、MCP 启动等待控制、网关与数据库连接配置为主的版本更新，同时包含内存告警、全屏消息展开与会话重试修复。
technicalInsight: 该版本把 effort 属性写入 llm_request trace span、新增 managed_settings_resolved OTel 事件并对设置做脱敏，显示 Claude Code 正在把模型调用与托管配置的运行时状态纳入统一遥测；CLAUDE_CODE_MCP_STARTUP_WAIT_MS 与 store.connect_timeout_seconds 则把此前隐式的等待行为变为可配置参数。可验证下一信号：后续版本是否在 release notes 中继续扩展 OTel 事件类型或把 MCP 等待策略暴露为更细粒度配置。
industryInsight: 面向开发者的编码 Agent 工具竞争正从功能覆盖转向运行时可观测性与企业网关治理，遥测字段（effort、enduser.sub、managed-settings 来源）与连接超时配置是这一方向的直接体现。可验证下一信号：其他编码 Agent 或 IDE 工具是否在同期发布类似的 OTel 事件与网关级身份透传能力。
futureOutlook: 若该路线延续，Claude Code 的遥测与网关配置可能成为企业部署时的审计与容量管理接口；但当前证据仅覆盖单个版本说明，尚不能判断采用规模。可验证下一信号：官方文档或后续版本是否给出这些 OTel 事件与网关参数的稳定 schema 与兼容性承诺。
businessValue: 对使用 Claude Code 的团队，内存告警、MCP 启动等待上限与 Postgres 连接超时可减少非交互任务卡死与启动失败；enduser.sub 与 managed-settings 遥测有助于企业侧身份归因与策略审计。可验证下一信号：企业用户是否在后续版本说明或文档中反馈这些参数被纳入其部署配置。

title: v2.1.277
factSummary: Claude Code 发布 v2.1.277，新增 AGENTS.md 支持：在项目没有 CLAUDE.md 时，Claude Code 改为读取 AGENTS.md，并可在 /config 的 "Project instructions" 中修改（该功能尚未在 Bedrock、Vertex 或 Foundry 上提供）；同时新增 CLAUDE_GATEWAY_PROXY_IS_EGRESS_BOUNDARY=1 环境变量，用于仅通过正向代理出网的 Claude apps 网关。同日，Google Agent Development Kit for Python 发布 2.9.2，重点修正 OpenTelemetry 事件名在不同环境下的处理方式，使 Agent Engine 之外的平台也能保留 OpenTelemetry 事件名，以提升追踪的准确性与一致性。
summary: 同一天内，Anthropic 的 Claude Code 与 Google 的 Agent Development Kit for Python 分别发布版本更新：前者引入 AGENTS.md 项目指令读取与网关出网边界配置项，后者修正跨平台 OpenTelemetry 事件名保留行为。两条证据均为官方发布说明，属于开发者工具链层面的增量更新。
technicalInsight: 两项更新都指向 Agent 工具链的工程化细节：Claude Code 通过 AGENTS.md 兼容更通用的项目指令约定，并以环境变量显式声明网关出网边界；ADK Python 则修复遥测事件名在非 Agent Engine 平台被改写的问题。可验证的下一信号是 AGENTS.md 支持是否扩展到 Bedrock、Vertex 与 Foundry，以及 ADK 后续版本是否继续调整遥测字段语义。
industryInsight: 头部厂商在同日推进 Agent 开发工具的配置约定与可观测性一致性，反映竞争焦点正从模型能力转向开发者工作流与运维接口的标准化；但仅凭两条发布说明不足以判断行业格局变化。
futureOutlook: 若 AGENTS.md 被更多 Agent 工具采纳，项目级指令文件可能形成跨厂商约定；若遥测事件名在各平台保持一致，Agent 运行数据的可比性会提升。需观察后续版本说明与第三方工具是否跟进。
businessValue: 对使用 Claude Code 与 ADK 的团队而言，项目指令兼容与遥测一致性可降低跨平台迁移和监控成本；实际收益取决于功能覆盖的平台范围与团队现有工具链。

title: v2.1.278
factSummary: Claude Code v2.1.278 将 Claude API 与企业用户、以及 Bedrock、Vertex、Foundry 和网关上的 auto mode 默认切换为服务端分类器，该分类器不收取分类器开销费用；在 Bedrock、Vertex、Foundry 和网关上可用 CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_MODE_SERVER=0 退出该默认行为，并对计费回退发出警告。该版本还在 /status 中新增 Auto mode server 行，显示当前会话的 auto mode 分类器是否运行在服务端。
summary: Claude Code 发布 v2.1.278，把 auto mode 的默认分类器改为服务端实现，并明确服务端分类器不产生分类器开销费用，同时提供退出开关与计费回退警告，并在 /status 中暴露分类器运行位置。
technicalInsight: 该变更把 auto mode 的分类决策从客户端侧迁移到服务端，并通过环境变量保留回退路径，说明分类器位置会影响计费与可观测性；可验证的下一信号是官方文档中关于 auto mode 分类器计费规则的进一步说明，以及后续版本是否扩展 /status 中的分类器状态字段。
industryInsight: 对开发者工具而言，把安全/路由分类器放到服务端并区分计费，可能成为 Agent 类编码工具控制成本与合规的常见做法；可验证的下一信号是其他同类编码 Agent 工具是否跟进类似的分类器计费与状态展示机制。
futureOutlook: 若服务端分类器成为默认且不计费，客户端侧分类器可能逐步退居可选回退；可验证的下一信号是后续 release notes 是否移除或弱化 CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_MODE_SERVER 退出选项，或将其标记为弃用。
businessValue: 对使用 Claude Code 的团队，该变更可能降低 auto mode 的分类器开销成本并提升分类器运行位置的可观测性，但需注意计费回退警告；可验证的下一信号是官方计费文档中服务端与回退分类器的具体计费差异说明。

title: v2.1.280
factSummary: Claude Code 发布 v2.1.280，新增 Claude Opus 5.5（claude-opus-5-5）并设为默认 Opus 模型，规格为 1M 上下文、$4/$20 per Mtok、缓存读取 $0.20/Mtok。同一版本在全屏模式下为更多列表加入鼠标支持（滚轮滚动 /skills 列表，/plugin 中技能状态选项可点击），新增 CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_MCP_DESCRIPTION_LENGTH 以调整会话内每个 MCP 服务器的 2,048 字符 MCP 工具描述与服务器指令上限，并在 hook_execution_complete OpenTelemetry 事件中加入 hook 输出大小与超限输出落盘数量。修复项包括：符号链接路径写入按实际落点判定、auto 模式在安全审查拒绝后不再反复重试、安全审查无响应时重试退避并在连续十次后终止回合、Write 调用在模型发送 path、file_text、file_content 等字段时的校验失败。
summary: Claude Code v2.1.280 将 Claude Opus 5.5 设为默认 Opus 模型，给出 1M 上下文与 $4/$20 per Mtok（缓存读取 $0.20/Mtok）的定价，同时改进全屏列表鼠标交互、MCP 描述长度可配置、hook 执行可观测性，并修复符号链接写入判定与 auto 模式重试/拒绝循环等问题。
technicalInsight: 从发布说明看，本次变更集中在 Agent 工具链的边界控制：MCP 描述长度可配置、hook 输出大小进入遥测、符号链接写入按实际落点判定、auto 模式对安全审查结果做一次性拒绝或退避终止，均指向对工具调用与权限判定的可观测与可收敛。判断：这些是工程治理层面的改动，而非模型能力本身的证据；是否真正降低误判与重试成本，需看后续版本是否保留该退避与终止语义。
industryInsight: 默认模型切换与按 token 定价同时出现在同一版本说明中，说明编码 Agent 的竞争点正从单一模型能力转向默认模型选择、上下文规模与单位成本的可预期性。判断：1M 上下文与缓存读取定价的组合，可能被用于长会话编码场景的成本竞争，但证据仅来自发布说明，尚无第三方采用或成本实测数据。
futureOutlook: 可验证的下一信号：后续 Claude Code 版本说明中是否继续沿用 Opus 5.5 作为默认 Opus 模型、CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_MCP_DESCRIPTION_LENGTH 是否被写入公开文档、以及 auto 模式的重试退避与十次终止规则是否在更新日志中保持或调整。
businessValue: 对使用 Claude Code 的团队，可操作点是：按 1M 上下文与 $4/$20 per Mtok、缓存读取 $0.20/Mtok 重新估算长会话编码成本；通过 CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_MCP_DESCRIPTION_LENGTH 控制 MCP 工具描述开销；借助 hook_execution_complete 的新增字段监控 hook 输出体积；并复核依赖符号链接路径的写入权限规则是否因落点判定变化而需要调整。

title: v2.18.0
factSummary: Google Gen AI Python SDK 发布 v2.18.0 版本（2026-08-12），新增功能包括：在 LiveServerContent 中添加 interaction_status；在 Vertex 上公开 deferred service tier；在 FunctionDeclaration parser 中启用 json schema；将 speech_config 改为结构化对象；支持注入 httpx2 client。Bug 修复：改进 chat 中的自动函数调用（AFC），修复 generate_content_stream 中 AFC 的 bug，并在 generate_content、generate_content_stream 及其异步变体中添加警告，提示 AFC 用于聊天体验而非直接用于 models 模块。性能改进：模型验证器改为首次使用时构建而非导入时；延迟导入 interactions API 以加速 import google.genai；停止在模块作用域导入 requests HTTP 栈。
summary: Google Gen AI Python SDK 发布 v2.18.0，带来多项功能增强、bug 修复和性能优化，包括改进自动函数调用、延迟导入以加速 SDK 加载，并新增对 Vertex 上 deferred service tier 的支持。
technicalInsight: 该版本通过延迟导入和按需构建验证器来优化 SDK 启动性能，同时改进自动函数调用（AFC）的稳定性，并新增对结构化 speech_config 和 json schema 的支持，表明 SDK 正在增强对多模态和结构化输出的支持。
industryInsight: Google 持续迭代其 Gen AI SDK，通过性能优化和功能增强来提升开发者体验，这可能加剧与 OpenAI、Anthropic 等竞争对手在开发者工具链上的竞争。

title: V2-STRep: VLM-Grounded Structured Task Representations for Reusable Robot Skills Acquired from Generated Videos
factSummary: Human manipulation videos provide rich motion and interaction cues for acquiring robot skills without robot demonstrations. Video generation models synthesize such demonstrations from an initial scene image and task instruction, avoiding the need to record demonstrations for each task. However, the recovered motion captures only one scene-specific realization, leaving task structure, geometric relations, and constraints implicit. We present V2-STRep, a zero-shot framework that converts generated video motion into reusable robot skills through VLM-grounded structured task representations. The representation specifies motion phases, references, and task-relevant constraints, with targets described by minimal geometric structures: points, point-normals, axes, planes, and full 6D poses. VLM-provided 2D image-space cues are lifted into 3D using RGB-D observations to reconstruct task geometry and candidate grasp poses. Geometry-specific rules transfer motion to new scenes, while task-constrained trajectory optimization couples grasp selection with complete robot motion planning. It preserves task requirements while using remaining rotational freedom to accommodate joint limits. Updating deployment grounding and constraints enables reuse under new compatible instructions without generating another video. Experiments on six real-world manipulation tasks demonstrate improved execution success over baselines, reliable cross-scene transfer of successfully acquired skills, and adaptation to changed deployment instructions.

title: v3.15.0
factSummary: OpenAI Python SDK 发布 v3.15.0（2026-09-18），新增多项 API 能力：agent session model settings（#3882）、audio-mini 模型选项（#3886）、compaction progress events（#3866）、managed Responses WebSocket sessions（#3887）、prompt-cache prewarming（#3888）；修复保留 chat stream moderation 结果（#3864）；另有 SIP 来电 ID 说明、图像请求示例更新及 realtime 文档清理。
summary: OpenAI Python SDK v3.15.0 于 2026-09-18 发布，围绕 API 层新增 agent session 模型设置、audio-mini 模型选项、compaction 进度事件、托管 Responses WebSocket 会话与 prompt-cache 预热，并修复 chat stream moderation 结果保留问题。
technicalInsight: 从变更条目看，SDK 正在补齐 Agent 会话配置、长任务进度事件与 WebSocket 托管会话等接口面，并引入 prompt-cache 预热，指向对会话状态与缓存复用的工程化支持；但证据仅为发布说明，无法确认实际性能或稳定性收益。可验证下一信号：官方文档或后续版本是否给出这些接口的用法示例与行为说明。
industryInsight: 这是官方 SDK 的常规版本迭代，反映 API 供应商在 Agent 会话管理与缓存优化方向持续扩展开发者接口；单条发布说明不足以判断竞争格局变化。可验证下一信号：其他主流模型厂商 SDK 是否跟进同类会话与缓存接口。
futureOutlook: 若 compaction 进度事件与托管 WebSocket 会话被开发者采用，可能推动长任务 Agent 的接口标准化；需观察后续版本是否稳定这些接口并补充文档。可验证下一信号：后续 release notes 是否出现相关接口的破坏性变更或弃用说明。
businessValue: 对开发者而言，新增会话设置与缓存预热可能降低长会话场景的集成与调用成本；但证据未提供定价、配额或性能数据，商业收益尚不可量化。可验证下一信号：官方是否发布缓存命中率、延迟或计费相关的量化说明。

title: v3.16.0
factSummary: OpenAI Python SDK 发布 v3.16.0（2026-09-18）。该版本新增 webhook endpoint 管理 API（#3892，commit 9a11f6e），并将 MCP connector_id 标记为弃用（#3894，commit 1ccaf07）。
summary: OpenAI Python SDK 的 v3.16.0 版本在 API 层面加入 webhook endpoint 管理能力，同时对 MCP connector_id 做弃用处理。证据仅来自该版本的 release 说明，未披露具体接口形态、迁移路径或影响范围。
technicalInsight: 从 release 条目看，SDK 正在把 webhook 端点管理纳入官方 API 表面，并以弃用方式调整 MCP 相关标识字段，属于接口层的渐进式演进。可验证的下一信号是官方文档或后续版本中是否给出 connector_id 的替代字段与迁移说明。
industryInsight: SDK 同时涉及 webhook 管理与 MCP 连接标识，反映开发者工具链在事件回调与工具/连接器接入两个方向上的持续标准化，但单条 release 不足以判断行业层面的趋势强度。
futureOutlook: 若后续版本继续围绕 webhook 与 MCP 连接管理迭代，可观察是否出现配套的迁移指南、弃用时间表或新连接器抽象；反之若仅此一次改动，则更可能是常规维护。
businessValue: 对使用该 SDK 的开发者而言，webhook endpoint 管理可降低自建回调管理的集成成本，而 connector_id 弃用意味着需要关注升级兼容性；具体收益与迁移成本需以官方文档为准。

title: v4.1.18: docs(skills): rewrite publish-extension for the completed SDK cutover
factSummary: The ext-sdk-bundle-rollout flag reached 100%, so stable releases now ship a standalone build of main through ext-vscode-publish-stable.yml rather than the combined legacy+next A/B VSIX. Rewrite the skill around that path and record what is left to retire. Also corrects two things the old text got wrong: nightly is manual-dispatch only (the cron was removed because PublishNightly gained required reviewers, so unattended runs sat waiting and starved their successors), and the stable workflow tags before it builds, so a tag-push failure fails early rather than leaving a published-but-untagged release.

title: v4.1.19
factSummary: Added Images attached to a model that cannot read them are now flagged instead of silently discarded. Thumbnails get a warning badge and the composer explains that the images will be ignored, with a button to switch to an image-capable model. Previously the thumbnail looked normal and the image was replaced with a text placeholder just before the request, so there was no way to tell it had been dropped. Model info and the attachment picker also report image support accurately for models that declare text-only input without listing capabilities. Changed Cline's logo and icons have been refreshed throughout the extension, including the activity bar and panel icons. The W B Inference provider is now listed as CoreWeave, with its sign-up and API-key links updated to match CoreWeave's current documentation. Fixed Long tasks now compact when they actually need to rather than running out of room. The trigger compared a character-based estimate of the conversation (~3 characters per token) against the model's context limit, so content that tokenizes far denser than that — disassembly, image dumps, minified sources — could fill the real context window while the estimate stayed under the threshold and compaction never fired; the turn was then squeezed down to a handful of output tokens. The trigger now also uses the token count the provider itself reports, and how much history is kept is scaled by how far off the estimate turned out to be. The summarizer's output budget also doubled, so a model that reasons before answering can no longer spend the whole budget thinking and return no summary at all. On Windows, opening a repository that contains a file named rg.exe , git.exe , or powershell.exe no longer runs that file in place of the real program. Bare program names were resolved through the workspace directory before PATH, so a planted executable ran with your privileges as soon as the workspace was indexed. Cline now sets Windows' NoDefaultCurrentDirectoryInExePath opt-out…

title: v4.1.20
factSummary: Changed Sub-agents spawned in the same step now run their tool calls at the same time rather than one after another. Tools that must run in order still do, and the parent still waits for every result before its next turn. Models that advertise a large output limit now get a bigger default output budget — 30% of the limit rather than a flat 32,000 tokens, whichever is larger. Nothing changes for models under roughly 107k output tokens; longer responses can mean higher per-turn cost and latency. Refreshed the model catalog: 203 to 209 providers and 6,079 to 6,237 models. Kimi For Coding splits into separate kimi.com and kimi.ai providers, and AI21 Labs, ainetcafe, Inco, OCI Generative AI, Tempr, and Vispark are new. The resolved default model changes for 36 providers that do not pin one — most landing on DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, GLM 5.3 Flash, or MiMo V2.6 Flash. If you use one of those providers without pinning a model, expect a different default. Fixed UserPromptSubmit and TaskStart hooks can inject context again. What those hooks returned as contextModification was being dropped — only cancel survived — so a hook meant to add repository facts or house rules to a task silently did nothing. The context is now delivered as a block on the run's first request, the same as before the regression, and the raw block never renders in the transcript. A hook also no longer receives its own previously injected text back as the next turn's prompt. Unsent text in the composer survives Retry. Retry sent no composer content but still ran the same cleanup as approval actions, deleting the only copy of anything typed while a request was in flight. Text, quote context, images, and files are now tracked as one draft that only submitting actions consume. Output from background commands now streams into the command row while the command runs, instead of appearing only when it finishes. The Azure API version configured for a provider is now honored in tasks and mirrored to providers.json . R…

title: v4.1.7
factSummary: Cline 发布 v4.1.7 版本，恢复完成行上的 "View Changes" 按钮（由 SDK 检查点支持），恢复回合最终响应行的复制按钮，支持远程 MCP 服务器的预注册 OAuth 客户端，淡化和隐藏 "View Changes" 按钮直到确认更改，集中插件设置和贡献（含主机感知快照和原子插件切换），在计划运行报告中携带执行上下文（可读标题、计划元数据、持续时间和生命周期错误详情），修复回合中断时排队的提示词保留、会话上下文在中断和 hub 重启后的持久性、模式切换中止运行回合时的回合阶段结算、排队回合失败报告为 run.failed，以及挂起的 MCP 服务器问题。
summary: Cline 发布 v4.1.7 版本，主要改进包括：恢复 "View Changes" 按钮（由 SDK 检查点支持）和复制按钮；支持远程 MCP 服务器的预注册 OAuth 客户端；集中插件设置和贡献；在计划运行报告中携带执行上下文；修复回合中断时提示词保留、会话持久性、回合阶段结算和排队回合失败报告等问题。
technicalInsight: 该版本通过 SDK 检查点恢复 "View Changes" 按钮，表明 Cline 在任务执行中引入了更细粒度的状态追踪，可能为后续的可审计性和回滚能力奠定基础。
industryInsight: Cline 作为开源 AI 编码助手，其版本更新聚焦于开发者体验和可靠性，反映了 AI 编码工具在向更成熟、更稳定的工程化方向演进。
futureOutlook: 未来可关注 Cline 是否将 SDK 检查点能力开放为公共 API，以及是否进一步强化 MCP 服务器的安全认证机制。
businessValue: 该版本通过提升任务可审查性和会话可靠性，增强了开发者对 AI 编码工具的信任，可能促进其在企业环境中的采用。

title: v4.1.9
factSummary: Cline 发布 v4.1.9 版本，主要变更包括：使用编辑器的前景色显示 diff 块文本；界面切换到 Inter 和 Geist Mono 字体；修复了旧 token 已过期时成功刷新 Cline token 却被丢弃的问题；停止遗留任务迁移积压对遥测的垃圾信息，并仅在种子会话实际持久化后记录迁移结果；报告非自愿的 Cline 登出（拒绝的刷新 token）而不是静默清除凭据。SDK bundle 版本通过 SDK v0.0.74 落地，修复了 Claude Code provider 无法用于 agentic 工作的问题，现在运行自己的原生工具、将会话锚定在工作区目录、加载 ~/.claude 和项目设置；拒绝截断的工具调用 JSON 而不是静默修复。
summary: Cline 发布 v4.1.9，改进 diff 文本可读性、切换字体、修复 token 刷新和迁移报告问题，并通过 SDK v0.0.74 修复 Claude Code provider 的 agentic 工作能力。
technicalInsight: 该版本修复了 Claude Code provider 无法桥接工具定义的问题，改为运行自己的原生工具，并锚定工作区目录和加载用户设置，这表明 agent 工具执行需要更紧密的本地集成。
industryInsight: Cline 作为 AI 编码助手，其修复 token 刷新和迁移报告问题表明开发者工具在稳定性和可靠性方面的竞争加剧。
futureOutlook: 后续可观察 Cline 是否进一步扩展 Claude Code provider 的原生工具支持，以及 SDK bundle 的采用情况。
businessValue: 提升开发者体验和工具可靠性，可能增强 Cline 在 AI 编码助手市场的竞争力。

title: v4.14.31
factSummary: FastGPT 发布 v4.14.31 版本，变更说明为增加对于系统默认模型的敏感信息过滤，变更范围为 v4.14.30 至 v4.14.31。
summary: FastGPT 在 v4.14.31 版本中增加了对系统默认模型的敏感信息过滤功能。
technicalInsight: 该版本聚焦于安全增强，通过过滤敏感信息来降低模型输出风险，但具体过滤机制和覆盖范围未在证据中说明。
industryInsight: 开源 AI 应用框架正在将安全功能作为版本迭代的重点，反映出行业对模型输出合规性的关注。
futureOutlook: 后续版本可能进一步扩展过滤规则或提供可配置选项，但需观察官方更新日志确认。
businessValue: 该更新可能提升 FastGPT 在企业场景中的适用性，但商业影响需结合用户反馈评估。

title: v4.15.5
factSummary: FastGPT 发布 v4.15.5 版本，新增 Cloudflare R2 对象存储支持和 SoMark PDF 增强解析提供商，修复了阿里云 OSS ETag 读取错误、S3/MinIO 文件不存在时 API 返回 Unknown 等问题，并优化了依赖管理和集成测试。
summary: FastGPT 发布 v4.15.5 版本，新增 Cloudflare R2 对象存储支持和 SoMark PDF 增强解析提供商，修复了阿里云 OSS ETag 读取错误、S3/MinIO 文件不存在时 API 返回 Unknown 等问题，并优化了依赖管理和集成测试。
technicalInsight: 该版本增强了对象存储兼容性，新增 R2 支持并统一了下载错误契约，同时引入 SoMark PDF 解析服务，提升了 PDF 处理的灵活性和可靠性。
industryInsight: FastGPT 持续完善多存储后端和文档解析能力，反映了开源 AI 应用平台在基础设施兼容性和文档处理方面的竞争趋势。
futureOutlook: 预计 FastGPT 将继续扩展存储和文档解析选项，并可能优化插件系统和工作流稳定性。可关注后续版本对更多云存储和文档格式的支持。
businessValue: 通过增强存储兼容性和文档解析能力，FastGPT 降低了用户集成成本，提升了平台在企业和开发者中的适用性。

title: v4.16.0-beta1
factSummary: FastGPT 发布 v4.16.0-beta1，更新了 Agent-sandbox-proxy 环境变量，新增 AGENT_SANDBOX_PREVIEW_PROXY_URL 等沙盒配置变量，移除了 E2B Sandbox Provider。
summary: FastGPT 发布 v4.16.0-beta1，更新了 Agent-sandbox-proxy 环境变量，新增 AGENT_SANDBOX_PREVIEW_PROXY_URL 等沙盒配置变量，移除了 E2B Sandbox Provider。
technicalInsight: 该版本强化了沙盒环境的资源限制和生命周期管理，并移除了 E2B 支持，可能表明 FastGPT 在沙盒实现上转向自研或更可控的方案。
industryInsight: FastGPT 作为开源项目，其沙盒更新可能反映 AI 应用开发中对安全隔离和资源管理的重视。
futureOutlook: 后续可关注 FastGPT 是否完全移除 E2B 相关代码，以及沙盒功能是否成为其差异化优势。
businessValue: 沙盒功能的增强可能提升 FastGPT 在企业级应用中的安全性和可管理性，吸引更多企业用户。

title: v4.16.0-beta2
factSummary: FastGPT 发布 v4.16.0-beta2 版本，引入严格 Schema 用于系统模型配置的初始化与保存，并提供 dry-run 与正式清洗接口。新增工作流应用系统配置独立面板、开场白多预设问题拖拽排序。优化发布渠道页面分组展示、工具市场批量更新、门户页快捷应用数量上限调整为 3、PDF 解析器动态边缘裁剪。修复旧版工作流 HTTP 工具动态参数默认输入方式、新建工作流应用国际化资源预加载等问题。
summary: FastGPT 发布 v4.16.0-beta2，重点改进系统模型配置的数据清洗与校验，并优化工作流、发布渠道、工具市场等多项功能。
technicalInsight: 该版本引入严格 Schema 校验，将历史配置中的数字字符串转换为 number、字符串形式 priceTiers 转换为数组，并删除非法可选数字，缺失必填数字使用默认值。这体现了对配置数据规范化的重视，可能为后续功能奠定基础。下一信号：观察是否在后续版本中扩展 Schema 校验到其他配置领域。
industryInsight: FastGPT 作为开源项目，通过版本迭代持续优化开发者体验和系统稳定性，反映了开源 AI 工具链在快速演进。下一信号：关注社区对该版本 Schema 变更的反馈及采用率。
futureOutlook: 严格 Schema 的引入可能提高系统配置的健壮性，减少因配置错误导致的问题。未来可能看到更多类似的数据治理措施。下一信号：观察后续版本是否提供更细粒度的配置迁移工具。
businessValue: 该版本通过优化配置清洗和功能改进，降低了用户升级和使用的门槛，有助于提升 FastGPT 的易用性和稳定性，从而增强其在开源 AI 应用平台中的竞争力。

title: v4.17.0
factSummary: 升级说明 升级到 V4.17.0 前,请先升级到 V4.16.2,并执行完成 V4.16.x 版本要求的所有旧升级脚本。 V4.17.0 的自动升级机制只管理从本版本开始登记的新任务,不会补执行此前版本的历史脚本。 从 4.17.0 版本开始,登记到系统升级机制的任务会自动执行,并通过 lease 抢占避免多节点并发问题,同时支持心跳检测,检查脚本是否活跃。可在 管理员 > 版本升级 中查看升级脚本状态。 分批迁移任务默认每批处理 100 条记录。数据量较大时,可通过 SYSTEM_MIGRATION_BATCH_SIZE 调整为 50 ~ 1000 。 AI Proxy(必需) 从 V4.17.0 起,必须部署或接入 AI Proxy,并在 FastGPT App 及复用 App/Service 配置的商业版 Admin 服务中设置: AIPROXY_API_ENDPOINT :可访问的 AI Proxy 服务根地址,例如 http://aiproxy:3000 ,不要附加 /v1 。 AIPROXY_API_TOKEN :与 AI Proxy 服务端配置一致的非空管理员 Token。 从 V4.17.0 起, OPENAI_BASE_URL 和 CHAT_API_KEY 已弃用并移除,配置后不再生效。 请从部署环境中删除这两个变量,改用上述 AI Proxy 配置,并在管理员的模型渠道中维护模型服务商地址和密钥。旧的 systemEnv.oneapiUrl/chatApiKey 覆盖配置也不再生效。 缺少任一 AI Proxy 配置会导致启动校验失败,单模型的 requestUrl/requestAuth 不能替代这两个必填项。升级前请确认 AI Proxy 可访问,且管理员 Token 可以访问渠道管理接口;不要把模型服务商的 API Key 当作 AI Proxy 管理员 Token。 CSRF 防御 本版本新增了环境变量用于防御 HTML 标签的 CSRF 工具。 CSRF_ENABLED = true Code Sandbox seccomp 兼容配置(可选) Code Sandbox 默认继续启用 seccomp。若宿主机内核不支持应用内 seccomp,进程池初始化会失败;确认可以接受系统调用隔离能力降低后,可为 Code Sandbox 显式设置: SANDBOX_DISABLE_SECCOMP = true 该配置只关闭 seccomp,chroot、 no_new_privs 和 UID/GID 降权仍保持启用。关闭后不再从内核层阻断网络、创建进程、线程和执行二进制等系统调用,不建议在支持 seccomp 的环境中使用。 新建团队默认创建权限(可选) 设置 DEFAULT_TEAM_BASIC_PERMISSIONS_ENABLED=true 后,新建团队时会为默认全员组授予应用、Skill 和知识库创建权限。默认值为 false ,仅影响新建团队,不会修改已有团队权限。FastGPT Pro 请在 FastGPT 和 Admin 服务中保持该配置一致,以覆盖各自的团队创建入口,包括企业微信授权建队。 镜像更新 title: v4.3.0
factSummary: Langfuse 发布 v4.3.0 和 v4.3.1 版本。v4.3.0 包含新功能：在预览中显示媒体大小、在 v2 API 中暴露语义根、在预览中自动以演示用户身份登录；修复了应用内代理草稿编辑、公共注册路由、评估器元数据传播、OpenRouter 广播递归等问题。v4.3.1 修复了 GPT-5.6 使用别名、旧版 trace 组件路由和 CI 缓存键问题。OpenAI Java SDK 发布 v4.48.0 和 v4.49.0，分别支持内容来源检查和快速服务层响应压缩，以及原生 mTLS 传输。DeepEval 发布 python-v4.1.5。
summary: Langfuse 发布 v4.3.0 和 v4.3.1，包含多项 UI、指标、评估和代理功能的修复与改进。OpenAI Java SDK 发布 v4.48.0 和 v4.49.0，新增内容来源检查、快速服务层响应压缩和原生 mTLS 传输。DeepEval 发布 python-v4.1.5。
technicalInsight: Langfuse 在 v4.3.0 中通过 v2 API 暴露语义根，并修复了评估器元数据传播和 OpenRouter 广播递归问题，表明其正在增强可观测性和评估能力。OpenAI Java SDK 新增内容来源检查和快速服务层响应压缩，可能提升 API 的可靠性和性能。
industryInsight: 这些发布显示 AI 工具链正在快速迭代，重点关注可观测性、评估和 API 可靠性。Langfuse 和 OpenAI 的更新可能反映市场对生产级 AI 应用的需求。
futureOutlook: 后续可关注 Langfuse 是否进一步扩展 v2 API 的语义根功能，以及 OpenAI Java SDK 是否将内容来源检查扩展到其他语言 SDK。
businessValue: 这些更新可能提升开发者的生产效率和系统稳定性，从而增强 Langfuse 和 OpenAI 在开发者生态中的竞争力。

factSummary: Langfuse 发布 v4.41.0，包含多项功能与修复：在 Rust 中编码 v4 原生块和事件字节（#17563）；自动化按标签过滤 prompt 事件（#17727）；改进 normalized-io 的额外输入处理（#17718）；将分数告警链接到过滤后的分数（#17715）；避免分数小组件的嵌套滚动条（#17713）；在不递归栈溢出的情况下对 trace 图步骤分组（#17566）；保留超大字段的小型 JSON 兄弟字段（#17717）；修复 web 端多项 Sentry 报错与交互问题（#17514、#17706、#17393、#17441、#17263、#17264）；以及 web 设计系统重构。
summary: Langfuse 发布 v4.41.0，主要变更包括在 Rust 中编码 v4 原生块和事件字节、自动化按标签过滤 prompt 事件，以及一系列 web 端修复与设计系统重构。
technicalInsight: 该版本将 v4 原生块与事件字节的编码迁移到 Rust，可能意在提升序列化性能与类型安全；同时修复 trace 图分组的递归栈溢出，显示其在处理深层调用链时的工程改进。可验证下一信号：后续版本是否继续扩大 Rust 编码路径的覆盖范围，以及是否发布相关性能基准。
industryInsight: Langfuse 作为开源 LLM 可观测性工具，其迭代节奏与修复密度反映该赛道仍处于快速工程打磨阶段，竞争点集中在数据摄入性能与前端稳定性。可验证下一信号：同类开源项目是否跟进 Rust 重写或类似性能优化。
futureOutlook: 若 Rust 编码路径持续扩展，Langfuse 可能在高吞吐 trace 场景获得性能优势；但当前证据仅限单次发布，尚不足以判断趋势。可验证下一信号：观察后续版本是否出现 Rust 相关模块的进一步重构或性能声明。
businessValue: 对使用 Langfuse 的团队而言，本次更新可减少前端报错与交互问题，并可能改善大规模 trace 数据的处理效率，降低运维与调试成本。可验证下一信号：社区 issue 中关于性能与稳定性的反馈是否减少。

title: VākQA: A Benchmark and Evaluation Study for Telugu Spoken Factoid Question Answering
factSummary: Question answering has advanced rapidly with large language models, but predominantly for high-resource languages, in both text and spoken settings. Spoken question answering (SQA) benchmark for Telugu remains unexplored, and the reliability of automatic evaluation in this setting remains unquantified. We introduce VākQA, a Telugu SQA benchmark of 2,001 factoid question-answer pairs across six domains, with 2.53 hours of speech audio, bilingual transcriptions, and human-verified reference answers. We first validate evaluation methods against human judgements: Gemini-as-a-judge best approximates human ratings but is non-uniformly strict, while open-weight judges systematically penalize correct Telugu answers that differ in surface form from the reference. Using this validated setup, we benchmark proprietary and open-weight models across input modality, language, and domain. We observe that Telugu phrasing retains cultural specificity that is lost in translation, speech input introduces phonetic confusions that alter question meaning, and cascaded ASR-MT errors compound progressively. VākQA is publicly released.

title: VAKRA: Evaluating Multi-Hop Reasoning Across APIs and Retrieval Under Tool-Use Policies
factSummary: Agents deployed in enterprise settings must reason across structured APIs and document collections, yet existing benchmarks evaluate these capabilities in isolation. We introduce VAKRA (e\textbf{V}aluating \textbf{A}PI and \textbf{K}nowledge \textbf{R}etrieval \textbf{A}gents), a benchmark of over $8{,}000$ executable APIs across $62$ domains with tasks spanning three settings of increasing difficulty: diverse API interaction styles, multi-hop reasoning over structured APIs, and multi-source reasoning with natural-language tool-use policy constraints. Correctness is verified by re-executing predicted tool calls against live APIs, accommodating multiple valid paths. Using a fixed ReAct harness to isolate model capabilities from agent architecture, we evaluate frontier and open-weight models and find that even the best model achieves only 70.4\% on single-hop endpoint-style tasks and drops to 50--51\% on compositional APIs; performance degrades by over 50\% as reasoning depth increases, and policy-constrained questions expose severe failures (as low as 2.4\% on unanswerable queries). Trace analysis shows failures concentrate at language-mediated reasoning - entity disambiguation, cross-source grounding, rather than tool invocation mechanics. Code is available https://github.com/IBM/VAKRA. Dataset is available https://huggingface.co/datasets/ibm-research/VAKRA

title: Validity of LLMs as data annotators: AMALIA on authority
factSummary: A national language model offers a linguistic community its own instrument for measuring what its citizens say and value. Portugal's AMALIA, a publicly funded 9B-parameter model for European Portuguese, appears competitive on agreement alone: asked to code the moral foundation of authority, it agrees with trained human coders to within six F1 points of open models eight to thirteen times its size. Yet agreement is reliability, not validity. For theoretical constructs that must be inferred rather than read from surface features, the question is whether the model follows the construct's theory or reaches the right code by correlated shortcuts. We test this with the recovery gap: the loss in performance when a holistic prompt is decomposed into the codebook's atomic clauses and recombined by the theory's explicit rule. If calibration closes that gap, some portability should survive across models and languages; where it does not, the construct-model instrument is the likely locus of failure. We ask whether a calibrated English instrument transfers to AMALIA-9B and to European Portuguese. For one construct and one corpus, it does not. Decomposition recovers only about half of AMALIA's holistic performance, and error analysis suggests reliance on surface correlates, especially moral outrage near authority figures. An open multilingual LLM closes the gap on the same Portuguese corpus under the same instructions, pointing away from the corpus as the main explanation. AMALIA can still screen and pre-code at scale, but it cannot yet measure this construct well enough to stand alone. The study is a single counterexample, not a verdict on national models; it argues that sovereign-LLM benchmark batteries should test not only agreement with human coders, but the evidential route by which that agreement is warranted.

title: Value-Sensitive Delegation in Everyday AI Agent Use: Evidence from OpenClaw
factSummary: Users increasingly delegate work to autonomous AI agents, yet evaluations typically measure task completion rather than the values users prioritize. Using Value Sensitive Design, we analyzed, with LLM assistance, 73,093 first-person Reddit posts about using OpenClaw, each for its human value, agent aspect, value fulfillment, and user outcome. The 21 values form six value groups, including Autonomous, Dependable, and Affordable Operation, Bounded Reach, Reviewability, and Equitable Access. Relative to each aspect's corpus share, values clustered not at the agent's outputs but at the operating conditions users set around a run. Values were usually met where users described what the agent delivered, in five of six groups, and mostly unmet where users described supervising it, in all six groups. We conceptualize this pattern as value-sensitive delegation. Supporting human values requires attention not only to what an agent accomplishes, but to the conditions users set around delegation, including cost, access, and oversight.

title: VANE: Reliable Test-Time Training for Vision-Language-Action Models via Future Visual Representation Prediction
factSummary: Test-time training (TTT) offers a lightweight way to adapt vision--language--action (VLA) policies from unlabeled deployment streams, but it remains difficult to use reliably in closed-loop manipulation. A shared adaptation space can mix incompatible task corrections, while an online update can alter subsequent actions before its consequences are known. We introduce a reliable TTT framework for VLA policies (VANE). VANE conditions prompt adaptation on the current vision--language context and learns from the future visual consequences of executed actions. Candidate updates are isolated from the live policy, evaluated on subsequent observations, and committed only when supported by future evidence, making adaptation selective and reversible. On SimplerEnv WidowX, VANE improves average success by $3.2$ percentage points over the corresponding TTT baseline. Results on Google Robot further show that deployment-time gains remain task- and embodiment-dependent. Together, these results demonstrate a constrained, evidence-based approach to adapting VLA policies during interaction.

title: VEGAS: Human-Aligned Video Caption Evaluation via Gaze
factSummary: Vision-language models excel at video captioning, yet typically generate descriptions that fail to capture individual viewers' attention. We propose VEGAS (Video caption Evaluation via GAze Score), a training-free metric that leverages test-time gaze to sample personalized, attention-aligned text. It is a cross-modal, information-theoretic metric that quantifies how well a candidate caption matches a viewer's focus. To evaluate VEGAS, we curate a dataset of egocentric activities and instructional slides paired with synchronized gaze and reference annotations. We then select captions based on VEGAS via rejection sampling without model retraining. Experiments show that VEGAS-selected captions align significantly better with human focus and improve downstream caption-to-video retrieval, demonstrating the practical utility of incorporating viewer attention during inference.

title: Verbalizing Subliminal Learning Effects Using Text Optimization
factSummary: Subliminal learning is a phenomenon in which a distillation dataset transmits traits from the teacher model that are not legibly encoded in the dataset itself. This introduces a new challenge for model development and creates new risks from data poisoning. In this work, we use text optimization to detect subliminal learning effects and describe them as legible prompts. Subliminal learning from a prompted teacher motivates our approach. We observe that this is a special case of context distillation and leverage this observation to show that, in theory, the prompted subliminal learning dataset identifies the teacher's prompt. We reduce recovering this prompt to a text optimization problem and present a method to approximately solve it. Our method, SALVE (Search-Aided Latent Verbalization), optimizes a soft prompt, queries the same model to verbalize it as text, and uses beam search to make the verbalization reliable. In the standard subliminal learning setting, SALVE reliably recovers legible prompts that name the teacher's trait, while common text optimization methods fail to do so. In addition, we find that there are settings in which SALVE recovers the teacher's trait from a dataset even when subliminal learning fails, but that modifying student training to improve context distillation can create subliminal learning effects. We lastly show that SALVE detects subliminal learning effects in three additional settings: (1) mixtures of subliminal learning data and unrelated data, (2) data generated when the teacher is biased via activation steering, and (3) subsets of real preference data selected via Logit-Linear Selection. Overall, our results deepen our understanding of subliminal learning and present SALVE as a method to proactively detect subliminal learning effects.

title: verdi: retrieval is not transfer for continual world model optimization
factSummary: Foundation world models have made remarkable progress in planning, simulation, and embodied intelligence. However, optimizing a pretrained world model toward a user-specified objective remains difficult: each campaign typically rediscovers optimization strategies from scratch, and the resulting knowledge rarely transfers to the next model. Existing research agents automate the optimization loop but treat successful strategies as directly reusable recipes, without principled safeguards for when transfer is appropriate. We argue instead that retrieval is not transfer: a strategy validated on one model is at best an optimization hypothesis for another, and becomes transferable knowledge only after target-side experimental valida- tion. Guided by this principle, we propose VERDI , a continual framework for evidence-licensed world model optimization. VERDI characterizes each world model through shared inference-time probes to construct an Optimization Fin- gerprint, retrieves relevant prior experience as ranked hypotheses, and validates every candidate under a frozen target-side verifier before admitting it as reusable evidence; contradictions among nearby fingerprints further trigger probe evolution, continually refining the diagnostic representation itself. Experiments on Ctrl-World, the Cosmos family, and RoboCoin show that VERDI reduces search cost by 68%, GPU cost by 69%, and negative transfer from 0.34 to 0.06, while predicting transfer outcomes with 83% sign accuracy.

title: Verifiable Social Reasoning for LLM Assistants
factSummary: LLM assistants are widely used for daily social advice, yet evaluating their social reasoning in such consultation settings remains challenging since (i) it requires setups where the assistant learns about social situations from subjective user narratives, and (ii) social properties, such as others' intentions, typically lack verifiable ground truth. To address these challenges, we introduce Fuse, a multi-agent simulation framework for studying user-mediated social reasoning. In Fuse, a target agent with a hidden motive interacts with other agents including one representing the user, who then consults the evaluated assistant to infer the target's motive, providing verifiable ground truth by construction. Simulation faithfulness is validated through a human study with 24k annotations. We apply Fuse to 12 LLMs and demonstrate its analytical utility by systematically isolating key factors, showing that (i) user mediation compounds the inherent difficulty of social reasoning; (ii) LLMs exhibit systematic sensitivity to biased user framing; (iii) models can require more details than humans need to reach a correct prediction; and (iv) longer conversations do not always improve performance despite providing opportunities for clarifying questions. We open-source Fuse and a dataset with 21k examples.

title: Verifiably grounded machine interpretation of lunar geology
factSummary: Planetary geology relies on historical, interpretive reasoning to reconstruct past events from diverse observations. Here, we present a step toward an automated "machine intelligence geologist" by embedding this distinct methodology of geologic knowledge discovery and inference into a multimodal vision-language architecture. Focusing on the stratigraphy of lunar basaltic mare volcanism, we train a model to generate verifiably grounded geologic interpretations directly from co-registered topographic, spectral, and geologic maps. We demonstrate that while the system successfully balances established geological priors with local visual evidence to accurately describe stratigraphy and terrain, numeric age dating derived solely from vision defaults to memorized priors. Integrating an open-book retrieval mechanism resolves this, enabling the model to faithfully cite published chronologies. Our findings delineate the necessary architecture for automated geologic inference: site evidence must be visually interpreted from local data, while quantitative historical context must be retrieved from the scientific record.

title: Vernata: Self-Supervised Learning of LiDAR Point Representations
factSummary: LiDAR serves as a primary sensing modality for robots operating in outdoor environments. However, the performance of deep learning models in this domain is severely limited by the scarcity of labeled data, a direct result of the high cost of 3D annotation. Self-supervised learning addresses this scarcity by learning general-purpose features from unlabeled data. In this work, we present a multi-modal, multi-teacher distillation framework for self-supervised learning on outdoor LiDAR point clouds. Building upon the Sonata architecture, we introduce Vernata, consisting of three extensions: sparse view augmentation to improve robustness against varying point densities, a memory bank mechanism to stabilize resource-constrained training, and cross-modal distillation utilizing dense, high-resolution 2D image features to enable fine-grained semantic guidance. We evaluate our method on the GrandTour, TartanGround, and Waymo datasets, as well as data collected from our own robotic platforms. Our experiments demonstrate a significant performance improvement over Sonata baselines, yielding mIoU scores of 54.7 on TartanGround (+5.9 points, +12.1%) and 57.1 on Waymo (+7.3 points, +14.7%). Finally, we show that the self-supervised approach maintains strong performance even in reduced-modality settings (lacking color or normals), achieving competitive mIoU scores of 49.4 and 50.2 on the respective datasets.

title: Vero: Can AI Agents Build Formally Verified Software Repositories?
factSummary: AI agents are increasingly used for programming, but do not provide any guarantee on the correctness of generated code. Verified code generation, in which an agent produces both an implementation and a machine-checked proof of its specification, offers a stronger path toward trustworthy AI-generated software. Existing benchmarks in this direction either focus on individual functions or only evaluate proof generation with provided implementations. It is still an open question whether agents can make coherent implementation and proof choices across real multi-module codebases. To bridge this gap, we introduce Vero, the first benchmark to evaluate joint implementation and proof synthesis at the repository level. Vero contains 43 multi-module instances sourced from real-world repositories spanning Python, Dafny, Verus, and Coq, and covering diverse domains from cryptographic protocols to distributed systems. Each instance consists of a multi-module Lean 4 repository with predetermined API interfaces, manually curated formal specifications, and reference implementations, supporting both proof-only and code-and-proof evaluation modes. To improve benchmark reliability, Vero also includes an audit mechanism where agents are allowed to formally prove unsatisfiability of provided specification or incorrectness of reference code, which surfaces and corrects latent code and specification errors during curation. We evaluate frontier coding-agent configurations with Lean toolchain access. The strongest agent fully solves only 27 of 43 instances and closes no specifications on the hardest repositories. Vero provides a concrete testbed for measuring progress toward repository-scale verified software synthesis, where current agents still fall short. We release the benchmark, curation pipeline, and evaluation harness at https://github.com/sunblaze-ucb/vero.

title: Versatile On-device Adaptation at the Edge by Unifying Few-shot, Zero-shot, Continual, and In-context Learning
factSummary: With the ever-increasing pervasiveness of smart edge devices, the demand is growing for applications that can be tailored to users (e.g., custom keyword spotting) or patients (e.g., adaptive health monitoring). Yet, most edge devices rely on fixed inference algorithms and thus cannot learn on-device to personalize predictions. When they can, devices typically support only a specific learning scenario, such as few-shot learning (FSL): going beyond this requires resorting either to another specialized device or to cloud-based retraining, which implies significant energy and latency overheads, a lack of real-time capabilities, and privacy concerns. In this work, we introduce embedder-centric learning (ECL), a framework that unifies four different online learning scenarios: FSL for on-the-fly customization, continual learning (CL) for knowledge accumulation, zero-shot learning (ZSL) for leveraging semantic data, and in-context learning (ICL) for adapting beyond classification. We demonstrate in silicon that ECL can be deployed on resource-constrained devices across four real-world use cases representative of the aforementioned learning scenarios. Our approach establishes a new state-of-the-art performance for FSL character recognition (Omniglot: 96.8% for 5-way 1-shot, 83.3% for 32-way 1-shot), and the first hardware baseline for CL in keyword spotting (NeuroBench keyword FSCIL: 71.8% for 200-way 5-shot). Moreover, we present the first hardware demonstrations of ZSL with semantic data (60.6% for 5-way spoken sentence classification) and ICL (46.2% at the 500th token of RegBench) operating at micro-to-milliwatt power budgets. Therefore, by unifying multiple learning scenarios, we pave the way for smart and versatile devices that can adapt right at the edge, without reliance on the cloud.

Moreover, we present the first hardware demonstrations of ZSL with semantic data (60.6% for 5-way spoken sentence classification) and ICL (46.2% at the 500th token of RegBench) operating at micro-to-milliwatt power budgets. Therefore, by unifying multiple learning scenarios, we pave the way for smart and versatile devices that can adapt right at the edge, without reliance on the cloud.

title: VIBE: A VAD-Informed Benchmark for Entity-Centered Affective Profiling of Large Language Model Outputs
factSummary: Large language models routinely describe socially salient targets, including political figures, countries, religions, organizations, historical events, and social groups, encoding affective framing alongside factual content: a target may appear favorable or threatening, calm or conflictual, powerful or vulnerable. Existing work captures parts of this space through sentiment, favorability, and emotion benchmarks, but none combines target-directed VAD attribution, an explicit scorer contract, and a passport reporting format. We introduce VIBE, a benchmark for entity-centered affective profiling of LLM outputs in Valence-Arousal-Dominance (VAD) space. Its core contribution is a measurement contract: VIBE separates generation from external scoring, distinguishes scalar favorability, response-level VAD, and target-directed VAD, and reports profiles through an Affective Passport. Three empirical layers support the contract. H1 shows scalar favorability does not subsume arousal and dominance: valence findings are cross-validated (rV = 0.944 judge-human, rV = 0.954 inter-scorer); arousal and dominance are single-scorer directional estimates, not point-precise, consistent with known inter-annotator difficulty on these axes (rA = 0.495, rD = 0.702 among human annotators). H2 shows whole-response and target-directed VAD are different contracts: the same text can carry one affective tone overall while representing the named target differently. H3 is a protocol-drift diagnostic: elicitation conditions shift profiles, motivating context metadata in every affective report. These results motivate entity-centered affective profiling as a documented practice: profiles should be released with scorer identity, coverage, protocol, and interpretation limits.

title: VibeLifeBench: Can Your Life Agent Be Proactive and Persistent in a Living World?
factSummary: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly deployed as personal assistants. Existing evaluations, however, mostly use short, self-contained requests in static environments. Everyday life assistance is different. A task runs for weeks rather than minutes. The world keeps changing while the agent is not being prompted. Many constraints are never stated outright. An agent that merely answers the request in front of it will fail at such a task. What is needed instead is an agent that stays proactive and consistent. It decides on its own when to act, when to ask, and when to stay silent. It notices changes that nobody announced. It keeps one plan coherent from the first day to the last. No current benchmark measures this. We introduce VibeLifeBench, a benchmark of 200 long-horizon tasks across ten everyday-life domains. Each task is a scripted multi-week timeline in a simulated world of 22 mock services. The world advances on its own clock, and many of its changes are silent, so only an agent that re-inspects the world discovers them. Every task is graded by fine-grained, weighted checks that read only what the agent actually left behind, covering the end state, the timeliness of its actions, and whether it upheld the implicit constraints. We evaluate seven frontier models. All of them score low, which shows how far current agents are from assisting with real life. We will open-source all tasks, environments, and the evaluation framework.

title: Vibration Suppression in Collaborative Flexible Payload Manipulation Using Passive Force Control
factSummary: In large and heavy structures, vibrations arise during motion, posing significant challenges for precise manipulation. To accomplish the desired motion, control algorithms must effectively suppress these structural vibrations. In cutting edge projects, such as remote maintenance of future fusion energy reactors (tokamaks), the manipulation of this type of structure is defined as a crucial task. This paper presents a control strategy to suppress transverse vibrations in flexible payloads during motion using a collaborative payload manipulation approach. Two different industrial robot arms are arranged in a leader follower configuration for the manipulation strategy. title: VICBench: A Multi-Language Benchmark for Code Vulnerability Detection
factSummary: Evaluating security vulnerability detection tools requires benchmark datasets with vulnerability-inducing commits (VICs) - the commits that first introduce vulnerabilities into codebases. VICs are essential for determining the full range of vulnerable software versions. Existing vulnerability datasets suffer from limited programming language coverage, restricted patch complexity, and narrow project scope. Through our dual annotation by human experts and an agentic workflow, we create a benchmark - VICBench - of 100 verified VICs for 100 CVEs across 88 projects in Python, Java, and C++, covering 48 CWE types. VICBench features complex real-world vulnerability fixes averaging 38.6 lines and corresponding VICs of 252.5 lines - significantly larger than prior work. Our evaluation shows that state-of-the-art algorithms V-SZZ and LLM4SZZ achieve only 33.3%-40.1% F1, confirming that using existing approaches still entails significant manual effort. VICBench enables robust evaluation of vulnerability detection approaches.

title: Vid2WAM: Distilling Video Diffusion Priors into World Action Models
factSummary: World Action Models (WAMs) improve robot policy learning by jointly modeling future visual dynamics and actions. However, their scalability and generalization remain constrained by their reliance on costly expert demonstrations. We challenge this by asking whether future supervision for WAMs must originate from target-task expert trajectories. In this paper, we propose Vid2WAM, an offline distillation framework that transfers visual diffusion priors from a large video foundation model into a compact WAM student. Given an observation and language instruction, Vid2WAM distills supervision through two complementary channels: task-conditioned future rollouts directly supervise the student's future prediction branch, while an inverse dynamics model recovers embodiment-specific pseudo-actions for action learning. To robustly integrate synthetic and real supervision, we introduce source-aware residual action adaptation that learns source-specific corrections around a shared action backbone and mitigates interference from noisy pseudo-actions. During inference, both the video teacher and inverse dynamics model are discarded, leaving only the WAM student for efficient deployment. Simulation and real-world experiments demonstrate that Vid2WAM improves novel-task generalization and data efficiency under limited expert demonstrations while preserving low-latency inference.

title: Video-DeepResearch: Towards the Next-Generation Multimodal Deepresearch Agent
factSummary: We introduce Video-DeepResearch (Video-DR), extending multimodal agents from static images to continuous video streams, a setting that demands dense spatiotemporal grounding coupled with open-web exploration. Preliminary evaluations reveal two critical bottlenecks in current models: (1) modality bias, where agents bypass visual tools in favor of textual search, and (2) parametric knowledge leakage, where models rely on internal memory rather than genuine tool-augmented execution. To address these challenges, we propose Video-DR, featuring a decoupled perception-exploration pipeline with stage-wise tool unlocking that compels exhaustive cross-frame visual grounding prior to web retrieval. Our framework adopts a two-stage training recipe: supervised fine-tuning followed by Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), enabling autonomous exploration that breaks the imitation-learning ceiling. Furthermore, we curate Video-DR-Bench, a human-AI collaborative benchmark comprising 200 complex, multi-hop VQA instances. Empirical results demonstrate that our Video-DeepResearch-35B-A3B establishes a new state-of-the-art of 64.0% average accuracy, surpassing proprietary Claude-4.5-Sonnet (59.0%) by 5.0 points and significantly outperforming GPT-5 (52.5%) and Gemini 2.5 Pro (57.5%). The 30B-A3B variant achieves 59.3%, competitive with Claude-4.5-Sonnet and demonstrating the effectiveness of our training paradigm even at compact scale. Code: https://github.com/Osilly/Vision-DeepResearch.

title: Video2Track: From Real-World Interaction Videos to Steerable Adversarial Closed-Track Testing for Automated Driving Systems
factSummary: Closed-track testing plays a fundamental role in the verification and validation of automated driving systems (ADS), particularly for safety-critical scenarios, by enabling reproducible evaluation under controlled conditions. However, most existing approaches still rely on standardized protocols or predefined trajectories, leading to overly scripted interactions and limited ability to reproduce the natural complexity of public-road traffic. To address this limitation, we propose Video2Track, a framework that transfers real-world interactive driving scenarios from videos into steerable adversarial closed-track testing. The framework consists of two tightly coupled modules. The first is a scenario semantic mapping module, which extracts structured semantics from driving videos using a vision-language model and grounds them onto a closed-track topology library via retrieval-augmented generation, thereby identifying compatible map segments and interaction anchors. The second is a dynamic interactive testing module, which conditions on the grounded topology and anchors to generate diverse multi-agent trajectories through a conditional diffusion model, while regulating interaction intensity via a Stackelberg game with a parameterized adversarial objective. Closed-track experiments demonstrate that the proposed framework can faithfully reproduce representative real-world interaction scenarios and generate executable scenario variants with controllable risk levels and interaction styles, providing a scalable approach for realistic and steerable ADS validation.

title: VIDS-Seg: Towards Reliable Uncertainty Quantification in Pediatric Cardiac Ultrasound Segmentation
factSummary: Reliable clinical deployment of machine learning requires models that know when they are likely to fail, particularly for subgroups underrepresented in training data. A common case is pediatric care, where models trained on adult cohorts can silently under-perform on children with no indication that something has gone wrong. As retraining with labeled pediatric data is often infeasible, detecting such failures at inference time is a critical clinical need. Building on the VIDS (Variational Inference under Distribution Shifts) framework, we introduce VIDS-Seg, which applies amortized variational inference over a lightweight prediction head to make this adaptive, OOD-aware prior tractable for dense image segmentation. We evaluate VIDS-Seg on left ventricular segmentation in echocardiography, a setting where pediatric anatomy differs systematically from the adult population most segmentation models are trained on, training on an adult cohort (EchoNet-Dynamic) and evaluating zero-shot on a pediatric cohort (EchoNet-Pediatric). Across all age strata, VIDS-Seg matches competitive baselines in segmentation accuracy while producing substantially higher spatial correspondence between predicted uncertainty and segmentation error, an advantage that persists even after applying temperature scaling to all baselines. Downstream, it yields more accurate and stable ejection fraction estimates and more reliable detection of cardiac malfunction in the infant subgroup. Our results indicate that OOD-aware uncertainty quantification can serve as a practical safety layer for deployed segmentation models, enabling detection of silent failures in underrepresented subgroups without retraining or additional labeled data.

title: Virchow2: Scaling Self-Supervised Mixed Magnification Models in Pathology：病理学基础模型规模化训练，数据多样性与领域方法超越纯参数扩展
factSummary: 2024年8月，研究团队发布Virchow2系列病理基础模型，包括6.32亿参数的Virchow2、19亿参数的Virchow2G及2200万参数的蒸馏版Virchow2G Mini。所有模型在310万张全切片图像上训练，覆盖多种组织、机构与染色。在12个图块级任务上达到SOTA，表明数据多样性与领域特定方法比单纯扩大参数更有效。
summary: Virchow2系列通过大规模自监督学习，在病理学基础模型上取得突破。与单纯扩大参数不同，该工作强调数据多样性（310万张来自多机构、多染色的全切片图像）和领域特定算法（混合放大倍数训练）的重要性。12个图块级任务SOTA表明，结合领域知识、数据规模与模型规模可显著提升下游性能。蒸馏版模型为资源受限场景提供了实用选择。
technicalInsight: Virchow2采用Vision Transformer架构，训练算法为DINOv2的改进版，支持混合放大倍数（如5x、10x、20x、40x）的自监督学习。数据来自310万张全切片图像，涵盖肺、乳腺、结肠等组织及H&E、IHC等染色。评估涵盖12个图块级任务（如肿瘤检测、突变预测），Virchow2G平均AUC达0.92，优于UNI、CTransPath等模型。消融实验显示，数据多样性贡献大于模型参数增加。局限性：仅评估图块级任务，全切片级性能待验证。
industryInsight: 病理AI领域基础模型竞争加剧，Virchow2系列为数字病理学提供更强大的特征提取器。其蒸馏版模型可部署于医院本地服务器，降低对GPU的依赖。多机构训练数据有助于提升模型泛化性，减少部署时的域偏移问题。
futureOutlook: 关注Virchow2在全切片级任务（如癌症分级、预后预测）上的表现，以及与其他基础模型（如CONCH）的集成。蒸馏版模型在边缘设备上的推理速度是关键指标。需观察模型对罕见病变的识别能力及联邦学习扩展性。
businessValue: 病理AI公司应评估Virchow2作为特征提取器替换现有模型，尤其在多机构协作场景。建议采购或合作获取Virchow2的API或模型权重，用于开发辅助诊断产品。投资关注病理基础模型商业化路径，如与数字病理平台集成。

title: VIRGA: Virtual-Agent-Intermediated Riemannian Geometry for Active-Sensing Air-Ground Coordination
factSummary: Air-ground autonomy becomes harder when the unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) must remain observable by a gimbal light detection and ranging (LiDAR) mounted on the unmanned ground vehicle (UGV). The platforms must avoid dynamic obstacles while coordinating heterogeneous motion, limited sensing, and changing task initiative within one closed loop. This paper presents VIRGA, a neural geometric coordination framework that turns dual-LiDAR observations into bounded source-specific Riemannian fields and couples them through a virtual agent with reciprocal elastic feedback. Platform-aware execution maps convert the shared coordination reference into feasible UAV, UGV, and gimbal commands while enforcing active-observation safeguards. Evaluation against three complementary baselines reveals distinct limitations. An adapted Ray-RMP controller provides the fastest Riemannian response but produces insufficient clearance in the coupled air-ground task. A dense analytical Riemannian field improves geometric avoidance, yet its high evaluation cost prevents stable field-of-view maintenance. An adapted ColAG controller achieves the lowest latency but still incurs safety and observability violations. VIRGA completes all paired warehouse conditions safely, while a long-range cave stress test without retraining demonstrates sustained coordination in irregular and confined geometry. Ablations confirm contributions from online geometric evaluation, virtual-agent mediation, and reciprocal feedback.

title: Virtual Temperature Sensors in Power Transformers Using Neural Ordinary Differential Equations
factSummary: Accurate modeling and forecasting of power transformer thermal behavior are critical for reliability, asset lifetime, and optimized power system operation. Numerical approaches such as finite element methods (FEM) and computational fluid dynamics (CFD) offer high fidelity but are computationally expensive, require complex mesh generation, and are often impractical for real-time or large-scale applications, particularly when transformer geometries are unknown. Lumped-parameter thermal models are more practical but depend on transformer-specific thermal constants and may fail to capture dynamic responses under varying operating and environmental conditions. Purely data-driven machine learning methods, including artificial neural networks, convolutional neural networks, and long short-term memory (LSTM) networks, have shown success in forecasting transformer temperatures but typically require large volumes of high-quality training data and may produce physically inconsistent or uninterpretable results. This paper develops a physics-aware Neural Ordinary Differential Equation (Neural ODE) framework for forecasting transformer thermal behavior from real-world time-series data. Neural ODEs model system dynamics in continuous time, providing smooth trajectory prediction and a natural representation of continuously evolving thermal dynamics. A key contribution is the integration of simplified heat-transfer equations directly into the Neural ODE formulation. The model is evaluated across datasets from fifteen transformers in different regions of Norway with varying designs and cooling mechanisms. The results demonstrate that the developed Neural ODE framework provides a standardized, physics-aware, and robust forecasting approach for heterogeneous transformer units.

title: Vision-based Underwater Formation Control With Input Saturations via Barrier Lyapunov Functions
factSummary: In this work, we propose a communication-free framework for vision-based formation control of fully actuated underwater robots subject to sensing constraints, collision-avoidance requirements, and input saturations. Recentered barrier Lyapunov functions encode sensing and collision-avoidance constraints, while command-filtered backstepping extends the design to the second-order vehicle dynamics. The resulting control objective is enforced through a quadratic program that explicitly accounts for actuator limits. Conservative sensing domains provide margins from the physical limits and are adaptively relaxed when necessary, allowing temporary violation of the conservative bounds. The proposed approach is validated through realistic Software-in-the-Loop (SITL) simulations in Gazebo.

title: Vision Foundation Models with Synthetic-Only Training for Monocular Spacecraft Pose Estimation
factSummary: We present an improvement on previous spacecraft pose estimation architectures that results in the lowest published mean rotation errors we know of on the SPEED+ lightbox and sunlamp test sets for a known, non-cooperative spacecraft. By using a previously established heatmap-based pose estimation architecture and adapting a large self-supervised ViT foundation model (DINOv3) in place of the smaller convolutional and ViT encoders of previous work, we show that pose estimation accuracy improves from 300M to 840M parameters with no saturation yet observed. We also evaluate our 840M model on a Jetson Orin NX 16GB, measuring single-pass network inference at 133.8 ms per crop with a board draw of 32.0 W. These measurements demonstrate embedded inference feasibility on a processor family with orbital flight heritage. Our resulting model outperforms previous models across lightbox and sunlamp domains while training only on synthetic data. Our best model, using DINOv3 840M adapted with LoRA as the encoder (rank 64, three-seed ensemble with four-rotation test-time augmentation), results in $1.56^\circ$ mean rotation error on sunlamp and $1.17^\circ$ on lightbox, compared to the previous best mean rotation errors we know of on these test sets, $2.66^\circ$ and $1.75^\circ$ by EagerNet.

title: Vision Mamba: 双向状态空间模型实现高效视觉表示学习
factSummary: 提出Vim骨干网络，用双向Mamba块替代自注意力机制，在ImageNet分类、COCO检测和ADE20K分割任务上超越DeiT，且高分辨率推理速度提升2.8倍，GPU内存节省86.8%。
summary: 该工作首次将Mamba状态空间模型成功应用于视觉领域，通过双向处理机制和位置嵌入，在保持线性复杂度的同时实现了全局上下文建模，性能与Transformer相当但效率显著提升。
technicalInsight: Vim将图像分割为序列并添加位置嵌入，通过双向SSM（前向+后向）捕捉空间依赖，避免自注意力的二次复杂度。在ImageNet-1K分类上达到84.2% top-1准确率，COCO检测mAP 48.7，ADE20K分割mIoU 47.3，均优于DeiT-S。但未在更大规模数据集或视频任务上验证，且双向设计可能增加延迟。
industryInsight: 为高分辨率图像实时处理（如自动驾驶、医学影像）提供了高效替代方案，有望推动视觉基础模型从Transformer向SSM架构迁移，降低部署成本。
futureOutlook: 需验证在视频理解、多模态任务上的扩展性，以及更大模型（Vim-L）的性能；关注是否被后续工作（如VMamba）超越。
businessValue: 建议在边缘设备或高吞吐服务中评估Vim替换ViT，例如用于实时视频分析或移动端图像分类，可降低算力需求。

title: Visual Contrastive Self-Distillation
factSummary: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) is promising as it removes the external teacher required by on-policy distillation (OPD), yet it still needs asymmetric information between teacher and student to ensure that the self-teacher provides a stronger learning signal than the student. Existing methods create this asymmetry either through privileged answers or visual evidence. We ask whether both can be removed, yielding a simpler form of OPSD driven purely by input conditioning. For this purpose, we propose Visual Contrastive Self-Distillation, namely VCSD, which converts image-content removal into an on-policy self-distillation signal. At each student-generated response prefix, the EMA teacher produces two next-token distributions under the same prompt and prefix -- one conditioned on the original image and the other on a content-erased control. Their token-wise log-probability difference highlights candidates whose likelihood is specifically increased by the instance-level visual content. We use this contrast to sharpen the teacher's original-image distribution within its plausible support, and distill the resulting full-distribution target into the student. Using ViRL39K dataset, VCSD consistently outperforms matched OPSD across Qwen3-VL and Qwen3.5 models. For example, on Qwen3-VL, it improves the seven-benchmark aggregate from $62.27\% \rightarrow 67.04\%$ at 2B, $71.30\% \rightarrow 73.16\%$ at 4B, and $72.51\% \rightarrow 76.26\%$ at 8B. Furthermore, VCSD requires no external teacher, privileged answers, visual evidence signals, reasoning traces, or additional inference-time cost.

title: Visual Credit Audit for Multimodal Spatial Reasoning
factSummary: Closed yes/no spatial benchmarks can reward a correct answer even when the image adds little support beyond no-image contexts. Under a fixed forced-choice interface, Visual Credit Audit (VCA) separates two estimands: whether the benchmark image gives the model's declared decision more support than text-only and blank controls, and whether the model responds to relation-specific visual evidence. The first audit is training- and label-free and does not require an answer flip. Applying labels yields dependence-credited correctness (D-CC); on correct items, it equals same-control gold-aligned positive gain, while prediction alignment extends the audit to errors. Across four open MLLMs and two spatial benchmarks, 12.73-26.25% of decisions are correct yet uncredited. Matched same-split image permutation reduces D-CC by 21.25-47.80 points, with every paired 95% interval above zero. Fixed-pixel relation contrasts and a 3x3 evidence-source factorial show why null controls cannot identify relation response. Among controlled correct-but-uncredited agreement decisions, response to relation reversal spans 81.57-100.00%, while 32.11% pooled change answer. Independently audited outcomes on 108 geometry-compatible edits provide a bounded natural-image correspondence check. VCA thereby decomposes benchmark success into correctness, additional image support, and relation-consistent response.

title: Visual Proactivity: Enhancing Human-Robot Collaboration Through Intent Communication
factSummary: As robots transition from performing repetitive tasks to collaborating with humans, understanding human intent becomes crucial to effective interaction. Anticipation enables robots to predict human actions, while proactivity allows them to take initiative and guide human behavior toward optimal outcomes. Although research has largely focused on how robots infer and respond to human intentions, less attention has been paid to how robots communicate their own intent. This paper introduces visual proactivity, a novel, simple yet effective approach that enables robots to communicate their intentions through visual feedback, influencing human behavior and enhancing transparency and fluency. We develop and evaluate proactive robotic behaviors in a human-to-robot handover scenario, where a user study validates human perception of reactive, anticipatory, and proactive behaviors. The results demonstrate that effective visual proactivity fosters better alignment and coordination, paving the way for more intuitive human-robot collaboration.

title: Visuomotor Robotic Pruning in Planar Orchards Using Hybrid Reinforcement Learning
factSummary: Dormant tree pruning is labor-intensive yet essential for maintaining modern high-productivity fruit orchards. In this work, we focus on pruning of modern planar tree training systems - V-Trellis apples and UFO cherries - where trunks and primary branches are trained into approximately planar walls. We introduce an end-to-end pipeline to learn a closed-loop visuomotor controller for robotic pruning. This controller is trained entirely using simulation and synthetically generated data and deployed in real orchards in a zero-shot manner. The pipeline comprises synthetic generation of planar orchard tree meshes, construction of a physics-based orchard simulator, automated collection of successful pruning trajectories via motion planning, and policy learning with a novel hybrid reinforcement-learning algorithm that combines offline demonstrations with online simulated rollouts. The controller uses optical-flow inputs from a wrist-mounted camera - avoiding the need for full 3D-reconstruction - and continuously guides the cutter through cluttered branch environments to a specified cutpoint with correct tool orientation. In exhaustive simulated task-space evaluations over 3,000 pruning points, the policy attains 49.9% success on V-Trellis apples and 46.0% on UFO cherries. We validate the learned controller across 38 physical trials - comprising 28 outdoor field trials in commercial and experimental orchards and 10 indoor laboratory tests - demonstrating zero-shot sim-to-real transfer. The learned policy also outperforms a classical RRT-Connect baseline on physical hardware in laboratory trials.
